about_the_game:
Specific content of the demo:

Offering a sneak peek into the first 2 levels of the game, and the first 4 heroes. This demo showcases the core mechanics as well as the Power Up shop.

This demo includes the following:

- First 2 levels: Castle Courtyard, and Rocky Desert.
- First 3 Heroes: Alric, Eleria, Ignis.
- Completing the 2nd level will unlock the 4th hero (Granite) which you can play with again in the first 2 levels.
- Power Up Shop: Where you can upgrade the abilities of your heroes and party (However the amount of upgrades are limited for this demo).



Tri Survive is a Roguelite RPG set in a fantasy medieval world filled with magical creatures and kingdoms to explore. Take control of three characters simultaneously, each with their own skill set and unique abilities, deemed to be the heroes of their nations.
One day, your home is suddenly invaded by demonic creatures from another dimension.
The three champions must unite their forces to stop the invasion and unravel the mystery surrounding the evil monsters wreaking havoc in your kingdom.

Three Heroes, One Player

In Tri Survive, you will simultaneously take control of three heroes and experience unique game strategies. All the characters at your disposal will offer different abilities tied to their role as Tank, DPS, or Healer.

Unlock new champions as you progress in the story, and activate several synergies between the party members to be tailored to your playstyle and preference!

The World of Tri Survive

Set in a medieval fantasy world, Tri Survive lets you experience the adventure through the eyes of seasoned heroes from different nations and backgrounds who suddenly find themselves amid an invasion by demonic creatures from another dimension.

Throughout your journey to free your home from the invaders, you will explore countless hand-drawn landscapes and cities to gather information on what is happening in the world and discover how these monsters managed to breach your kingdom.

Survive The Horde

Want to take a break from saving the world and test your skills? The Endless Survivor Mode is the challenge you are looking for!
Fight infinite waves of monsters and train with your favorite heroes unlocked during the Campaign by measuring your skills and survival instincts. Get a personal score at the end of each run and prove yourself and the world to be worthy of the heroes trusting your commands!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 capable GPU
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4690
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon R7 265
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Action Roguelite that blends elements of Vampire Survivors with Fantasy RPG themes. Introduces a unique mechanic where the player controls a party of three heroes instead of one, offering a fresh strategic gameplay experience. Featuring JRPG-inspired hand-drawn art style and an intriguing storyline.
